upload_command: The Raphinha Experiment Will Break La Liga

Raphinha’s central role is giving Barcelona more ways to hurt a defence. His three goals against Sevilla showed three different movements—and three different decisions defenders have to make.

This film looks at Hansi Flick’s experiment, the supply from Lamine Yamal and Pedri, and what rivals must prepare for. Featuring perspectives from Shaka Hislop, Alejandro Moreno and Herculez Gomez.
